propositions: The applier re-attempts the same inbound link ADDs on every reconcile pass when the link is structurally impossible (source closed, redundant ancestry, cycle), because failed writes do not land events and the differ re-emits the identical record.
Without durable memory of permanent failures, the bridge logs 200+ known-doomed writes per hour indefinitely, forming a permanent error floor that masks real faults.

A digest over the structural inputs that decide each failure type (endpoint status, parent chain, deps) allows skipping writes when the inputs have not changed, and re-attempting exactly once when they do.
Cycle verdicts depend on the transitive dependency graph, so a cycle record must invalidate on any global structural change to avoid suppressing now-possible links.
The impossible links store must be committed to the tickets branch alongside bindings.json so the record survives between CI passes and takes effect in production.
